Increased regulatory scrutiny may force platforms to invest more in privacy-preserving age assurance technologies.

This is a HOW error. The government assumes that increasing the penalty (the HOW) will change the outcome, ignoring the technical reality of how kids bypass age-gating.

The Unavoidable Truth: The government's current policy is not stopping children from using social media.
